name: Agonizing Thorns

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure Path: Bastion of Blasphemies

disable: DC 27 Survival check to delicately unthread the vines from the skeleton without triggering them; four successes are required to disable the haunt.

items.name: The Thorns Need Blood
items.text:
Trigger A person attempts to damage the vines or to Interact with the skeleton or its armor

---
Effect The thorny vines suddenly animate, and in so doing, make it appear that the skeleton is rising to attack. The vines lash out, and all creatures in area B2b or within 20 feet above take 8d6 slashing damage from the thorns (DC 29 basic Reflex save save). A creature that fails the save also takes 1d6 persistent,bleed damage (2d6 persistent,bleed damage on a critical failure).

text: A massive tangle of brambles weaves through a skeleton clad in armor.
